name: TOTP Enrollment Confirmation Succeeds
summary: The authenticated user submits a valid six-digit authenticator code, TOTP becomes enabled for the durable identity, and fresh recovery codes are issued.

preconditions.expression: an authenticated durable identity has a staged authenticator secret from the current enrollment attempt and TOTP is not yet enabled

inputs.name: Verification Code
inputs.description: Current code generated from the staged authenticator secret by deterministic test setup.

serverInteraction.intent: Verify possession of the staged authenticator secret, enable TOTP, and issue recovery codes.

postconditions.expression: TOTP is enabled for the durable identity and fresh recovery codes have been issued by the successful confirmation operation

sourceReferences.note: ConfirmTotpEnrollmentAsync is the real manager operation that verifies the code, enables TOTP, and returns recovery codes.
POST /api/auth/mfatotp/enrollment/confirm exposes the current confirmed-user REST operation.
The web component calls the generated confirmation operation but currently discards the returned recovery codes and does not model a success state.
